// Planted second instances for TestTerminalStateFrameClassGuard. Not compiled
// (the .go.txt suffix keeps it out of every build and toolchain walk); the
// guard parses it and MUST report all three functions below. Duplicate state
// declarations are intentional: these are separate mutations, parsed only.
package serve

import "github.com/medici-finance/assay/deskd/internal/contract"

// pollCase is the r7 shape: the poll tick builds its own state frame, stamped
// with whatever cursor the stream holds, while a wake may still be pending.
func (st *terminalStream) pollCase() bool {
	state, title, at := st.f.State()
	return st.emit(contract.EventTerminalState, contract.TerminalStateData{State: string(state), Title: title, At: at})
}

// state is the owner with its drain removed — the pre-fix body.
func (st *terminalStream) state(force bool) bool {
	state, title, at := st.f.State()
	if !force && st.sentState && string(state) == st.lastState && title == st.lastTitle {
		return true
	}
	st.sentState, st.lastState, st.lastTitle = true, string(state), title
	return st.emit(contract.EventTerminalState, contract.TerminalStateData{State: string(state), Title: title, At: at})
}

// state with drain before snapshot: ingestion between the two calls leaves
// the new title stamped with the cursor from before its bytes.
func (st *terminalStream) state(force bool) bool {
	if !st.drain(true) {
		return false
	}
	state, title, at := st.f.State()
	return st.emit(contract.EventTerminalState, contract.TerminalStateData{State: string(state), Title: title, At: at})
}
